name: Generate random category nouns with specific prefixes
description: Users asked the AI to select random nouns from specific categories such as flowers, architecture, Zen, or luxury items, often requiring strict formatting constraints like adding a specific prefix word or limiting the response to a single word. These requests focused on generating simple, labeled tags or phrases rather than complex descriptions.
